title: Physical Regularity Criteria for Massless Scattering Theory
exact_target: Replace the technical spectral regularity assumption in massless-background Haag--Ruelle scattering by a physically meaningful condition.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30000327 (OWR-1105-001). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Analysis and Quantum Theory (2005), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2005/44, pp. 2493--2518; official report source and mathematical context.
Official EMS Press PDF of the same Oberwolfach report; PDF pages 7--8, printed pages 2499--2500.

status_qualification: The report excludes electrically charged infraparticles through the sharp-mass hypothesis. The exact quantitative Herbst assumption is in the cited scattering article rather than in this short report passage; no invented exponent or spectral bound is substituted here.
